job.reader_question: Which of the 28 specified isolation claims (I-1..I-25 and I-27..I-29) are actually enforced by a test, and where does each one live?
job.text_summary: Twenty-seven of the twenty-eight specified isolation claims (I-1..I-25 and I-27..I-29; there is no I-26) are each discharged by a named test in exactly one of three files: 25 in crates/brokerd/tests/isolation.rs, I-13 in crates/mcp/tests/i13_tool_registry.rs, and I-17 in crates/core/tests/isolation_i17.rs. I-10's row is entirely empty: it is implemented nowhere, an accepted risk (K-1) rather than an oversight — its positive half needs presence attestation, which no transport in this build supplies, though its negative half is proven three times over by tests outside this table (i21, i21b, and success_criteria.rs criterion 2).
job.title: Isolation suite: I-1..I-29 by implementing test file
